messages.subject: java.lang.NullPointerException (No Data Viewer Loaded)
parts:
Hi all,
I'm running Deducer on OSX 10.9.2. I don't know why today I received this error with no Data Viewer:

Loading required package: DeducerExtras
> java.lang.NullPointerException
 at org.rosuda.deducer.JGRConnector.idleEval(JGRConnector.java:39)
 at org.rosuda.deducer.Deducer.idleEval(Deducer.java:611)
 at org.rosuda.deducer.data.DataViewerController.refreshData(DataViewerController.java:212)
 at org.rosuda.deducer.data.DataRefresher.run(DataViewerController.java:252)
 at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:695)

 Do you know how I can fix this issue?

Thanks in advance

David

Many objects found.

save.image() #save workspace

You can try to fix this...seems a bug
bye

messages.subject: Re: java.lang.NullPointerException (No Data Viewer Loaded)
parts:
For better or worse, the behavior of automatically loading the users saved workspace is just how R works. That said, there must have been some odd object causing the null pointer exception which shouldn't happen. So that is definitely a bug. Unfortunately, since the objects have been deleted, there is no way to tell what the offender was.


beest,
Ian
